name: Ingrid Lindgren
action: Ingrid accepts Anna Lindqvist’s invitation to the kräftskiva and heads to the restaurant for the dinner.
reason: She has a history of skipping social events unless they offer clear business value, and this invitation comes from a manager she respects with whom she has already exchanged spreadsheets and collaborated before. The night nurse is arranged for 9 p.m., so she can attend without neglecting her mother, and she also knows business relationships often strengthen over shared meals.
